content.short: Metalaunch is a Web3 launchpad that helps builders raise capital and gives the community early access to token deals.
content.description: Metalaunch is a Web3, AI, and Metaverse launchpad that helps promising builders raise capital while giving the community early access to outlier token deals. It operates across multiple chains, including Avalanche, Polygon, Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, and OP Mainnet, letting top projects raise funds while the community taps into exclusive opportunities. Each Metalaunch project is rigorously vetted and hand-selected by the Metalaunch council to ensure quality and integrity.
